2608.00641.title: DASH: Decoupled Adaptive Surrogate - Acquisition Harness for Automated Bayesian Optimization
2608.00641.paper_summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) relies on a surrogate model and an acquisition function, yet the most suitable choices vary across tasks and optimization stages. Automated Bayesian optimization (AutoBO) addresses this variability by adapting BO components online. However, existing AutoBO methods either adapt one component, leaving the other mismatched and creating a bottleneck, or jointly select surrogate--acquisition pairs under a shared criterion, overlooking their distinct roles: surrogate selection depends on predictive reliability, whereas acquisition adaptation should respond to campaign context.In this paper, we propose DASH, a Decoupled Adaptive Surrogate--Acquisition Harness for large-language- model (LLM)-enhanced AutoBO. DASH selects surrogates by predictive reliability, uncertainty calibration, and ranking consistency; its two-stage acquisition controller periodically reallocates quotas across acquisition functions, builds a BO shortlist accordingly, and delegates final selection to an LLM. DASH also incorporates an integrated harness, consisting of knowledge-guided warm start and structured memory, to ground optimization in domain knowledge and accumulated feedback. Across four chemical optimization tasks, DASH outperforms the best AutoBO baseline by 12.51% in trajectory-level Acceleration Factor and 5.00% in endpoint Enhancement Factor. Results remain strong across LLM backbones, and ablations verify the complementary contributions of all components. Full-table and behavioral contamination checks find no detectable evidence that direct benchmark memorization or source-cell leakage explains these gains.
2608.00641.paper_summary_zh: 貝葉斯優化（BO）依賴於代理模型和獲取函數，但最合適的選擇在不同任務和優化階段中有所不同。自動貝葉斯優化（AutoBO）通過在線調整BO組件來解決這種變異性。然而，現有的AutoBO方法要麼只調整一個組件，導致另一個不匹配並產生瓶頸，要麼在共享標準下共同選擇代理--獲取對，忽視了它們的不同角色：代理選擇依賴於預測可靠性，而獲取調整應該響應活動背景。在本文中，我們提出了DASH，一種為大型語言模型（LLM）增強的AutoBO設計的解耦自適應代理--獲取系統。DASH通過預測可靠性、不確定性校準和排名一致性來選擇代理；其兩階段獲取控制器定期在獲取函數之間重新分配配額，根據此建立BO候選名單，並將最終選擇委託給LLM。DASH還包含一個集成系統，包括知識引導的熱啟動和結構化記憶，以將優化基於領域知識和累積反饋。在四個化學優化任務中，DASH在軌跡級加速因子上比最佳AutoBO基準提高了12.51%，在端點增強因子上提高了5.00%。結果在不同的LLM骨幹上依然強勁，消融實驗驗證了所有組件的互補貢獻。全面的表格和行為污染檢查未發現可檢測的證據表明直接基準記憶或源單元洩漏解釋了這些增益。
